visualObservations: The garden and flowers are visible and the hero fades into the pastel page instead of ending with a hard card edge.
At the approved 676px/125% composition, the larger portrait cluster spans the heading and counter on the right and the hero left edge sits close to the growth card edge.
All four English tile titles are one line at 676px/125%. At 576px/125%, three titles wrap cleanly.

The reduced-transparency hero and counter panel compute opaque fills with no backdrop filter in both themes. Forced colors provides system foreground and panel colors. Reduced motion stops selected animations.
Settings focus outline and light action-label contrast issues were resolved and rechecked.
limitations: Visual comparison establishes closer composition and material treatment, not pixel identity with the supplied image.
The active Growth orb decorative ring exceeds its own clientWidth; this is excluded from functional overflow totals.
